officialText:
Section 701.31 – Revise Section 701.31 to read as follows:

701.31 Ground Fault Protection of Equipment. The alternate source for legally required standby systems shall not be permitted to have ground fault protection for equipment with automatic disconnecting means. Ground fault indication of the legally required standby source shall be provided pursuant to 701.6(D).
